lines.en: The butterfly flits over the milkweed.
Its wings open and close, lightly.
It loops once along the flowers.
It rises over a tall stem.
It settles on a bloom and rests.

lines.zh: 它又飞起来，去了下一朵
lines.en: It lifts off for the next.
Its path wanders.
The wind shifts it a little.
It glides along a leaf's surface.
It passes another one close.
Each keeps its own heading.

lines.zh: 它在一处光斑里停了一下
lines.en: It pauses in a patch of light.

lines.zh: 它绕回来，又去同一朵花
lines.en: It returns to the same flower.
It flies so low it almost touches ground.
It draws a line across your view.
It drifts above the grass tips.

lines.zh: 它的翅纹在阳光里很清楚
lines.en: Its pattern shows clearly in the sun.

lines.zh: 它转了个弯，飞向更远的花
lines.en: It turns toward flowers further off.
The butterfly rests with wings out.

lines.zh: 它的触角轻轻点了两下
lines.en: Its antennae tap twice.
It slowly closes its wings.
The wind rocks the flower, and it with it.
It rolls its fine proboscis back in.
It shifts half a step on the petal.
Its wings open and close with breath.
A bee passes; it does not stir.
It turns its body to the sun.
Then it opens its wings again.
Its shadow falls on the petal.

lines.zh: 它把翅抖了抖，翅粉飘落
lines.en: It shakes its wings; dust drifts down.

lines.zh: 蝴蝶飞过来，在你面前停住
lines.en: The butterfly flies up and hovers before you.

lines.zh: 乳草丛边，我们二五成群。
lines.en: By the milkweed we fly in twos and fives.
It lands on your sleeve.
Its wings fan gently.
It takes two steps on your hand.

lines.zh: 它对你的手指很有兴趣
lines.en: Your fingers interest it.
It tries to unroll its proboscis.
Finding no flower, it flies off.
It comes back once.
And lands on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 蝴蝶歪了一下，翅拍得乱了
lines.en: The butterfly lurches; its wingbeats tangle.
A small piece of wing edge tears.
It drops below the flower and rises.
It clamps both wings shut.
Its antennae curl inward.
It flies low and hurried.
It hides under a leaf.
A little wing dust scatters.
It tries again and wobbles badly.
It still heads for the flowers.
The butterfly heads for the flowers.
It circles the flower's heart.
The fine proboscis goes deep into the bloom.
It clings to the flower and keeps feeding.
It moves to the next bloom and feeds.
Sated, it rolls the proboscis away.
It rests on a petal.
Anything but a flower it leaves alone.
It flies toward a denser patch.
It makes a loop and doubles back.
The butterfly is nudged off course.
It steadies and flies on.
A wing beats against your hand.
It dips and rises again.
It steers around your face.

lines.zh: 它把你的影子当成阴凉
lines.en: It takes your shadow for shade.

lines.zh: 它在你的影子里停了一下
lines.en: It pauses inside your shadow.

lines.zh: 然后它飞向有光的地方
lines.en: Then it flies toward the light.
A wingtip grazes you.
It does not change course for that.
It keeps going between the blooms.
As if it were merely passing through.
Two butterflies spiral together.
One rises and the other sinks.
Two pairs of wings beat on one count.
They jostle onto the same bloom.
Their antennae touch.

lines.zh: 然后一只飞起，另一只跟上
lines.en: One lifts off; the other follows.
They loop half around the patch.
The sun lights both pairs of wings.

lines.zh: 它们最后落在不同的花上
lines.en: At last they land on different blooms.
The patch goes quiet again.
The butterfly lands and unrolls its beak.
The proboscis goes into the bloom.
It feeds until its wings stop.
It shifts its mouth and feeds again.

lines.zh: 它对不是花的东西没反应
lines.en: It does not respond to anything but flowers.
It rolls the proboscis back up.
It circles this one flower.
It rests on a leaf beside it.
It moves to the next bloom.
This time it stays longer.
The butterfly climbs and circles you.
It lands on your shoulder.
It flattens its wings into the light.
It drops toward your hand.
It lands on top of your knuckle.
Its antennae keep probing.
It tries to unroll its proboscis.
Seeking flowers, it settled on you.
It circles your wrist.
It stops still on your skin.

lines.zh: 蝴蝶在你身边绕来绕去
lines.en: The butterfly keeps circling you.

lines.zh: 它几次停歇又几次飞起
lines.en: It settles and lifts, over and over.
It takes your hand for a flower.
Its proboscis unrolls and rolls back.
It weaves in and out between your fingers.
It rests without moving at your cuff.
It inches its way onto your wrist.
Your sweat puzzles it.
It tries a small touch.
Then it drifts away.
The butterfly bumps your face, barely.
Wing dust sticks to your eyelid.
It loops twice over your head.

lines.zh: 它的小足在你鼻梁一抓
lines.en: Its tiny feet catch on your nose.
It lands by your ear and beats its wings.
It crawls inside your collar.
It touches at your neck.
You swat; it is knocked aside.
It swings straight back.
It hangs before you and will not leave.

lines.zh: 乳草丛上多了一点颜色
lines.en: A fleck of colour appears over the milkweed.
The butterfly rises out of the leaves.
It skims half around the flower patch.
Its wings go translucent in the sun.
It settles on a new bloom.
It opens and shuts its wings slowly.
A gust shoves it half a foot off.
It corrects itself back onto its line.
It goes from bloom to bloom and back.

lines.zh: 它落在离你很近的地方
lines.en: It lands very near you.
A touch of flame curls a wing and it drops.
It lands with a wing crumpled.
Wings wet, it sticks to the surface film.
The blast flings it right out of sight.
An arrowhead tears one of its wing membranes.
Odd force whirls it in place.
Unfed so long, it flies unsteadily.
A white flash, and it balls up.
One pull from the void and it falls fast.
